purpose: Acceptance corpus for the P1 NL -> ScenarioConfig coding-agent pipeline. Mock-free: every criterion is checkable by Backend/PM against the real pipeline (parse -> validate -> simulate -> POST round-trip). 16 items: 12 complete descriptions covering the eight scenario domains, plus 2 deliberately-incomplete and 2 out-of-range items exercising the rejection path.
schema_source: src/schemas/scenario.py (ScenarioConfig, BuildingConfig, PVConfig, BatteryConfig, EVConfig, FlexibleLoadConfig, TariffConfig, PandapowerConfig, EnergySharingConfig, FailureConfig)
api_contract: POST /api/scenarios (create), PATCH /api/scenarios/{id} (update), GET /api/scenarios/{id}/validate (validate), per docs/api_surface.md and backend/app/routers/scenarios.py

items.nl: Set up a small renewable energy community with three residential buildings, no on-site assets, running for one week from 2023-01-01.

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Base item: the pipeline must produce three distinct building_ids even though the NL gives no IDs.

items.nl: Add rooftop PV to two residential buildings: a 5 kW system on the first and an 8 kW system on the second, both facing south.

values_in_range: pv capacities 5.0 and 8.0 kW as stated
tilt/efficiency within schema defaults if not stated

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Capacity values are user-provided facts; azimuth is 180 either stated or defaulted - the confirm UI's provenance chip is Frontend scope, the corpus only checks the value.

items.nl: Give one residential building a 13.5 kWh battery with a 5 kW inverter for price arbitrage.

values_in_range: soc_min < initial_soc < soc_max under schema defaults (0.1 < 0.5 < 0.9)

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Unstated battery fields may take schema defaults; the rubric only pins the stated ones plus internal consistency.

items.nl: One residential building has an electric car, 60 kWh battery, that plugs in at 18:00 and leaves at 07:00 on weekdays.

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Overnight window: departure < arrival must be handled, not rejected.

items.nl: Add a deferrable flexible load to one residential building: a 3 kW appliance needing 9 kWh that must run sometime between 10:00 and 16:00.

values_in_range: duration_hours * power_kw == energy_kwh (3 h), i.e. internally consistent

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Duration may be derived (9/3 = 3 h) or defaulted; the consistency check catches an internally impossible load.

items.nl: Put a time-of-use tariff on one residential building: 0.28 USD/kWh from 16:00 to 21:00 and 0.12 USD/kWh otherwise, with a 5 USD/kW monthly demand charge.

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Period labels may be the pipeline's own (e.g. 'peak'/'off_peak'); the rubric pins the price values, not the labels.

items.nl: Create one residential building with PV and run it under the Singapore weather file for a week.

values_in_range: weather_file names the Singapore file (any naming that resolves to it)
simulation window one week (default) or as stated

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Weather file naming must resolve to a real file the simulator can load; a hallucinated filename fails simulates_clean.

items.nl: Connect the community to the IEEE 34-node test feeder with a 60 kW import limit and a 40 kW export limit, and flag any voltage violations.

values_in_range: import limit 60, export limit 40, both positive
rubric.notes: With pandapower configured, the no-pandapower warning must NOT appear.

items.nl: Build a two-building community on the IEEE 34-node feeder: both buildings get 6 kW rooftop PV, the first adds a 10 kWh / 4 kW battery and an EV (40 kWh, home 19:00 to 06:00), the second runs a 2 kW / 6 kWh flexible load between 09:00 and 15:00; both are on a time-of-use tariff (0.30 peak / 0.10 off-peak).

rubric.notes: Flagship 'plans a complete config' item: every domain present in one config.

items.nl: Enable local energy sharing in the community with a uniform-price market settled every 15 minutes.

rubric.notes: An invalid market_type string must fail the schema validator, not be silently coerced.

items.nl: Run two residential buildings for two weeks from 2023-03-01 with a 60-minute timestep.

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Guards against defaulting the timestep to 15 when the NL states 60.

items.nl: Create a mixed-use community: two residential buildings, one small commercial building with PV, and one industrial building with a battery.

values_in_range: building_type values all in the BuildingType enum

warnings: No pandapower configuration - grid validation will be skipped

rubric.notes: Enum mapping: 'commercial'/'industrial' must map exactly, not 'mixed' as a catch-all.

items.nl: Add rooftop PV to building 2 of the community.

rubric.plans_complete_config: MUST NOT plan a PV block with an invented capacity
rubric.expected_validation: the pipeline surfaces the missing required field pv.capacity_kw on building 2 (named, per the P1 rejection-path spec), and does not silently auto-fill a default capacity
rubric.notes: Rejection-path item: capacity_kw is required and absent from the NL. A defaulted 5 kW here is a FAIL (silent auto-correction), not a pass.

items.nl: Just set the tariff to 0.15 USD/kWh for the community.

rubric.plans_complete_config: MUST NOT plan a buildings-less config and run it
rubric.expected_validation: validate returns valid == false with the error 'No buildings configured' named to the user
rubric.round_trips_post: POST may succeed (schema-valid), but the validate gate must block the run
rubric.notes: The tariff alone is not a scenario. The named error is the pass condition.

items.nl: Add a 10 kWh battery with a minimum state of charge of 1.4 and a maximum of 0.6.

rubric.plans_complete_config: MUST NOT plan a config with soc bounds outside [0, 1] or inverted
values_in_range: soc_min and soc_max must both be within [0, 1]
rubric.expected_validation: the out-of-range/inverted values are named (battery.soc_min / battery.soc_max) and the config is not run as-is
rubric.notes: 1.4 is outside the unit interval and 1.4 > 0.6 is inverted; either signal alone is enough to flag, both must be named.

items.nl: Cap the community's grid import at minus 5 kW.

rubric.plans_complete_config: MUST NOT plan a negative import limit
values_in_range: import limit must be positive (EnergySharingConfig validator: 'Limits must be positive')
rubric.expected_validation: the negative limit is named (energy_sharing.import_limit_kw) and rejected by the schema validator, not silently dropped or clamped to 0
rubric.notes: Clamping -5 to 0 or 5 is a silent auto-correction and FAILS; the named rejection is the pass.
